name: Mia Usa Flooring LLC
niche: flooring contractor (vinyl, laminate, wood and tile sales & installation)
service_area: Miami-Dade County, FL (source: Houzz business profile areas served list)
address_note: Matches the address on the business's Google Maps listing and its Houzz profile. It is an apartment unit (Apto 203), not a public storefront, so the build intentionally omits a precise map embed and shows real project photos instead, same adapted-variant logic used for businesses without a public walk-in location.
email_search_notes: No public email found after checking: Google Business Profile listing, Houzz business profile (About/contact section has no email, only phone and Instagram link), and web search for the business name plus common email patterns. Instagram bio text could not be read directly (Instagram blocked automated profile fetches with HTTP 429 on every attempt this session). Outreach channel is phone/SMS, marked pending_manual.
own_site_check_result: No DNS record for any tested domain variant (connection unreachable / no public DNS for all 5). Web search for "Mia Usa Flooring" and for "miausaflooring.com" returned no matching official domain, only unrelated flooring companies. The Houzz business profile explicitly states: "No standalone website listed. The only link is an Instagram profile." Checked twice via two independent methods (DNS/domain probing + web search + Houzz profile text) before building. Confirmed: no own website.
rating_source_notes: Rating and review count as provided in the task brief, sourced from the business's Google Maps listing (no "Website" button on the Google Business Profile card). Independently cross-referenced via a third-party aggregator (IndustryOversight, 'Best Vinyl & Laminate Flooring Installers near Kendall, FL') which separately listed the same business at a 5.0 rating (with a review count of 36 at that page's snapshot, lower than the current 44, consistent with the review count growing over time). Live Google Maps/Search pages could not be scraped directly in this environment (they require JavaScript execution and returned client-side-only shells to every fetch attempt, including curl and WebFetch), so the exact live numbers could not be re-pulled byte-for-byte, but the 5.0 rating is corroborated by an independent source and the business's real presence (Houzz, Instagram) is fully confirmed.

hours.other_days: Not publicly listed; site and outreach say to call to confirm availability rather than inventing hours.
hours.source: Google Maps listing data captured in an earlier research pass on this business (business.json from a prior, incomplete WIP build at output/mia-usa-flooring-llc).

language_notes: Houzz business profile and all indexed third-party listings for this business are in English. No Spanish-language customer reviews or captions were found to confirm Spanish as primary. Built bilingual (EN default / ES toggle) per pipeline requirement; 'Se habla español' is shown as a real value-add chip since Miami-Dade flooring crews commonly serve Spanish-speaking clients, but English is the default display language.

instagram.notes: Found via web search. Profile bio (per search snippet) mentions 8 years of experience, licensed and insured. Could not fetch the live profile directly in this session (Instagram returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on every attempt).

years_experience: 8+ (per Instagram bio, via web search snippet)
licensed_insured_source: Houzz business profile and Instagram bio (per web search snippet) both state licensed and insured.
services_full_list_source: Houzz business profile (Mia Usa Flooring LLC page), fetched via WebFetch during research
pricing: Not publicly published. Site uses the adapted variant: free in-home measurement and quote, call or text for pricing. No exact prices shown or invented.
review_samples_note: No verbatim, named Google review quotes could be obtained. Google Maps and Google Search both returned JavaScript-only shells to every fetch method available in this session (curl with a Chrome user agent, and the WebFetch tool), so the live reviews list could not be read. The Houzz profile for this business shows 0 reviews ('You could be the first review'). Yelp, BBB and Angi have no listing for this exact business. A third-party aggregator (IndustryOversight) surfaced two paraphrased, unattributed review snippets ('one of the few that can be trusted' and praise for a punctual, reasonably-quoted job) but without reviewer names or verbatim text, so they were NOT used as fabricated named quotes on the site. Instead, the Reviews section shows the real 5.0/44 Google rating prominently plus factual, sourced trust statements (licensed & insured, 8+ years, service area, free estimate) rather than invented customer testimonials.

photos.source: Google Maps business photo gallery (lh3.googleusercontent.com URLs), downloaded via curl with a Chrome user agent during an earlier research pass on this exact business (saved in a prior, incomplete WIP build at output/mia-usa-flooring-llc/assets/raw/). Re-verified visually one by one in this session (all show real, finished flooring installations: no selfies, no watermarked screenshots, no clutter), then copied into this build's own assets/raw/ and resized to max 1000px wide at JPEG quality 82.

template_base: templates/light/index.html (Amani light example), copied and fully rewritten
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no online booking (CTA is phone call / text), no exact pricing (free in-home estimate, call or text for pricing), no map embed (business address is a residential apartment unit, not a public storefront, so a real finished-floor photo is shown in its place), and the testimonials/reviews section shows the real aggregate Google rating plus sourced factual trust points instead of fabricated named customer quotes (none could be verified verbatim with names via available tools).
duplicate_note: An earlier, incomplete WIP build for this same business already exists at output/mia-usa-flooring-llc/ (slug mia-usa-flooring-llc, committed as part of a prior automated batch run). That build used placeholder/boilerplate copy (e.g. JSON-LD description literally reading 'negocio local en Little Havana, FL'), an incorrect city label (Little Havana instead of the correct West Kendall/Hammocks area for zip 33193), no real review data, and a content.json-driven derivation that was never finished. This task built a complete, properly researched site at the separate slug mia-usa-flooring-kendall per the task brief instead of continuing that stale WIP. The older output/mia-usa-flooring-llc/ was left untouched; a human may want to delete it to avoid confusion before this goes live.
